label: YouTube Dynamic
description: Creator-led YouTube videos with energetic B-roll, selective kinetic text and frequent purposeful visual refreshes.
intent: Make the premise clear quickly; reward attention with proof, novelty and rhythm rather than nonstop effects.
opening: Show the actual subject or useful result early; make the title/thumbnail promise legible in the opening.
editing: Cut by idea and emphasis. Vary shot length; use punch-ins or inserts for specific narrative reasons, not a metronome.
typography: One dominant sans family, two weights at most per shot; kinetic emphasis on meaning-bearing words; minimal text at once.
sound: Dialogue first. Short accents at important transitions only; intentional silence and restraint are allowed.
critique: Ask whether each visual refresh adds information, contrast or emotion.

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
